title: From identified risk to security requirement

videos.script: Seventeen threats on a list do not protect anything. Somebody has to build something, and builders work from requirements, not from threats. {{list}} So each threat needs a decision. Most get mitigated. A few get removed, or handed to someone else, or accepted on purpose. {{decision}} A mitigation becomes a requirement. And a requirement is only worth writing if somebody can check it. The portal must be secure is not a requirement. The portal returns an exam only to the patient it belongs to is one, and a test can prove it. {{testable}} Today you write the clinic's requirements and join each one to its threat. Then a small program finds the threat nobody covered, and the requirements nobody checks. {{trace}}
